findings.current: On the surface, she was also one of the chief contributors to his rescue, alongside me.
findings.defect: The source calls Honglan the 일등 공신—the foremost or chief contributor—not one member of a group of chief contributors.
findings.rationale: “One of the chief contributors” weakens the specific rank and public credit assigned to Honglan in the source.
findings.replacement: On the surface, she was also the chief contributor to his rescue, alongside me.

findings.current: They used the daggers issued to them as standard equipment and stabbed themselves in the throat.
findings.defect: “Issued to them” adds an institutional provisioning mechanism that the source does not establish. The source says the government troops normally carried daggers as basic equipment.
findings.rationale: 소지하고 있던 describes what the soldiers carried or possessed, not necessarily weapons formally issued to them.
findings.replacement: They used the daggers government troops normally carried as standard equipment and stabbed themselves in the throat.

summary: The chapter is largely faithful, with two minor fidelity defects involving rank and the mechanism by which the soldiers possessed their daggers.
